newsitem.title: USA: NYSE says Q1 net was $22.4 mln vs $21.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: NYSE says Q1 net was $22.4 mln vs $21.4 mln.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange reported on Thursday that it had revenues of $143.8 million and net income of $22.4 million for the first quarter of 1997, compared with revenues of $134.9 million and net income of $21.4 million for the first quarter of 1996.
The exchange also posted expenses of $104.4 million in the first quarter of 1997, compared with $97.1 million in the year-ago period.
Average daily trading volume for first quarter 1997 was 514.6 million shares, the exchange said, up from 427.5 million shares in the comparable period of 1996.
It added that in first quarter 1997, 39 companies joined the list of NYSE-listed stocks, compared with 44 in the year-ago period.
